components.name: Diagram/User journey map
components.description: Customer journey across 3–6 stages: actions, touchpoints, an emotion curve and the pain points / opportunities each stage reveals. Default is the wide canvas (web, workshops, print); Compact stacks one card per stage for mobile. Emotion uses dot colour + a word, never colour alone. React: <JourneyMap stages={[{ name, action, touchpoints, emotion, pain, opportunity }]} layout="default | com
